text: The forward post at a quarter to two. Two vans, a folding table, a screen with two times on it.
Kowalczyk and Arakawa pack the breaching case. Something he says makes her laugh. Malhotra runs the comms check with HaX, his badge by his headset.
Magnus Netherton. I run this shop. Gather in.
Agent 0x47, Nightshade. Fifteen years one of ours. He gave them the database. He is in the van, and he has said one word since.
Four and six. Both are his.
An archive in Helena, last night, gave us three things. The first is a name.
The Architect is Dr Adrian Tesseract. We proved it from his own hand.
Our former chief strategist. He trained me, and half the field. He walked out seven years ago.
Well enough to know he's expecting us.
At six he publishes everything we ever catalogued. Every flaw, with working detail, free, to anyone.
City by city from six. Or everywhere in the same minute, if someone presses his key.
The cells get it at four, two hours early, as pay for stealing our database.
His own sheet says eleven hundred to twenty-six hundred, if the key is pressed. City by city, fewer, and later. Not few.
Full disclosure is one researcher, one flaw, published to everyone, usually after the vendor stops answering. This is every weapon we hold, handed out at once.
He rang me last night. He called me Ninety-nine. Nobody has since the course.
The door will open for 0x00, he says. We should take our time getting there.
He has invited us. We are going in anyway, because the alternative is six o'clock.
The handbook has a chapter on raids by invitation. It is one page long. It says don't.
For the record, I'd go in at noon tomorrow with twice the people. You don't walk through a door a man's kept for you.
Noted, Agent Quintero. The record also says six o'clock.
Your clock, then.
Quintero leads on the ground. Kowalczyk breaches. Malhotra runs comms from the van.
Arakawa liaises. The sheriff has closed the county road for him, and nobody asked who for.
Four for their head start. Six for everyone else.
Kowalczyk hands you a PIN cracker in a matte casing. No stores label.
This one's mine. Never been through stores.
HaX. Go.
Netherton and HaX walk you to the van end. Through the open door the team packs, out of earshot.
